description: SYNTHETIC scripted judge verdicts for the offline harness. These are NOT model output. They exist so the judge prompt, the schema-constrained response contract, the parser, the acceptance threshold, and the manual-agreement metric can all run end to end with no model call and no cost. The scores were chosen to exercise the plumbing, not to represent what a real judge would say: gen-penalties is scored down on groundedness and unsupported claims to match the fabricated figure in the scripted answer, and gen-substantial-improvement is deliberately scored below the acceptance threshold on completeness so the committed baseline contains one judge-versus-human disagreement and the agreement metric is provably not stuck at 1.0.
